headline: Record sales, margin beat, demand outruns supply
summary_short: ASML reported record Q3 2026 net sales of €11.66B (+25.0% q/q) with gross margin of 57.5% and net income of €4.96B; basic EPS was €12.95.
summary_long: Net sales rose 25.0% q/q to a record €11.66B, towards the high end of guidance, with Installed Base Management at €3.29B, above guidance. Gross margin widened to 57.5% from 54.0% and net income rose to €4.96B. New system shipments reached 113 units versus 86. ASML bought back about €4.1B of shares in the quarter and declared a €1.88 interim dividend. Q4 2026 net sales are guided to €14.2–15.2B at a gross margin around 57%; full-year 2026 net sales are guided to €44–45B at around 56%. Management says planned 2027 and 2028 supply will not fully meet customer demand.
confidence_notes: Figures are in EUR as reported (US GAAP). The shard's EPS of 11.82 is a Yahoo USD-converted figure and differs from the release's basic EPS of €12.95, so the release value is used. The y/y EPS delta compares €12.95 with the shard's prior-year value of €5.49 (Yahoo timeseries, EUR). The release gives no Q3 2025 comparatives, so only q/q deltas are shown for the other rows. The release states no prior guidance for Q4 or FY2026, so guidance move is not assessed; forward ranges are captured in extendedMetrics only.

drivers.explanation: The CEO attributes the record quarter to strong execution of the ramp-up and says customers keep raising demand forecasts, driven by their views on the size and duration of AI-related investment.
Record sales reflect execution of the production ramp-up; new system sales rose to 113 units from 86 in Q2.
Came in above guidance on continued strong demand for productivity upgrades.
Margin finished above guidance, which management links to the stronger Installed Base Management sales.
Net income rose faster than net sales as gross profit grew from €5.04B to €6.70B on the higher margin.
